File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.scheduleSlots = function(start, end, duration, busy)

reference.code: const f=(s,e,d,b)=>{const ok=x=>Number.isSafeInteger(x)&&x>=0&&x<=1e7;if(!ok(s)||!ok(e)||!ok(d)||d===0||s>e||b.some(x=>x.length!==2||!ok(x[0])||!ok(x[1])||x[0]>x[1]))return null;const a=b.filter(x=>x[1]>s&&x[0]<e).map(x=>[Math.max(s,x[0]),Math.min(e,x[1])]).sort((x,y)=>x[0]-y[0]),m=[];for(const x of a){if(m.length&&x[0]<=m.at(-1)[1])m.at(-1)[1]=Math.max(m.at(-1)[1],x[1]);else m.push(x)}let p=s;const o=[];for(const[x,y]of [...m,[e,e]]){while(p<=1e7-d&&p+d<=x){o.push(p);p+=d}p=Math.max(p,y)}return o};exports.scheduleSlots=f;
